tooltip.starbridge.survey_core: Recovered from the lunar vault. The heart of an efficiency matrix.
tooltip.starbridge.starlit_crystal: Mined beneath Survey Moon's tuff plains. Powers fuel cells and core modules.
tooltip.starbridge.star_chart: Keep in your inventory. Above Y 250 (Overworld) or Y 150 (Moon), press J at the helm or use it on the core to jump the whole ship.
tooltip.starbridge.hull_marker: Right-click: corner A · Sneak + right-click: corner B · Right-click your core: scan, then again to assemble
tooltip.starbridge.upgrade.install: Right-click a ship core to install (max %s)
message.starbridge.not_owner: Only the ship owner or an operator can control this core.
message.starbridge.core_selected: Core selected. /starbridge pilot opens the helm. Right-click with fuel to charge (sneak for the whole stack), with a module to upgrade, with a star chart to jump.
starbridge.message.core_summary: Vector Drive Core · %s / %s FE · Capacitor %s · Thruster %s · Efficiency %s
starbridge.message.upgrade_full: %s is already at its maximum level.
starbridge.message.jump_arrived_moon: Star jump complete: Survey Moon. The ship is parked; launch it (L at the helm) before descending. Your hull supplies air while the core has power.
starbridge.message.jump_arrived_home: Star jump complete: Overworld. The ship is parked; launch it (L at the helm) to fly.
starbridge.message.jump_relaunch: Star jump complete. Reopen the helm with /starbridge pilot and launch.
starbridge.message.pilot_occupied: This core already has an active pilot.
starbridge.message.pilot_unloaded: Pilot session closed: the ship core is unloaded.
starbridge.message.pilot_inactive: Pilot session closed: an active player is required.
starbridge.message.pilot_dimension: Pilot session closed: you and the core must be in the same dimension.
starbridge.message.pilot_no_telemetry: Ship telemetry is unavailable. Assemble the ship and wait for the core to refresh.
starbridge.message.pilot_range: Pilot session closed: stay within 512 blocks of the ship.
starbridge.message.agent_started: Agent bridge on 127.0.0.1:18765. Token file: %s. Enable each core with /starbridge agent allow true.
starbridge.message.select_core_first: Right-click your ship core to select it first.
starbridge.message.selected_unloaded: The selected core is not loaded.
starbridge.message.assembly_scanning: Scanning %s × %s × %s (%s cells). Nothing moves until you confirm. Stop machines and item transfers first.
starbridge.message.assembly_ready: Scan ready: %s blocks, %s block entities, %s → %s. Right-click the core with the hull marker again (or /starbridge_assemble confirm) to assemble. Valid for five minutes.
starbridge.message.assembly_confirmed: Assembling %s blocks: rechecking the selection and writing a backup first. Stay in this dimension.
starbridge.message.assembly_backup: Backup written. Assembling now; a large ship can pause the server briefly.
starbridge.message.assembly_done: Ship assembled from %s blocks and parked. Charge the core, then /starbridge pilot and press L to launch.
starbridge.message.marker_need_corners: Mark two opposite corners of your ship with the hull marker first.
starbridge.message.marker_a: Corner A set at %s %s %s. Sneak + right-click for corner B.
starbridge.message.marker_b: Corner B set at %s %s %s. Right-click a block for corner A.
starbridge.message.marker_box: Hull box %s × %s × %s (%s cells). Right-click your ship core to scan.
starbridge.message.oxygen_empty: No oxygen! Use a canister, board a powered ship or return to the outpost.
starbridge.message.oxygen_refilled: Oxygen: %s s. Wear the oxygen mask to breathe.
starbridge.message.vault_enraged: The custodian overloads! Its gravity pulses quicken and more sentries arrive.
starbridge.message.vault_unlocked: The vault is unlocked. Right-click the lodestone terminal to recover your survey core.
starbridge.message.moon_unavailable: Survey Moon is unavailable: check the datapack errors in the server log.
starbridge.message.moon_admin_enter: [Operator transport] Survey Moon. The outpost beacon supplies oxygen within 7 blocks. The vault is east at %s.
starbridge.message.moon_no_return: No return point is recorded. Fly home with a star chart, or ask an operator.
starbridge.message.moon_return_missing: The recorded return dimension is unavailable; nobody was moved.
starbridge.message.moon_return_blocked: The recorded return position is obstructed. Nothing was changed; the record is kept.
starbridge.message.vault_active: The custodian is awake. Defeat it to unlock the survey core.
starbridge.message.vault_awakened: The vault custodian has awakened! Return to the terminal after victory.
starbridge.message.vault_defeat_first: Defeat the vault custodian before recovering its survey core.
starbridge.message.vault_claimed: You already recovered your survey core from this vault.
starbridge.message.vault_inventory_full: Make room in your inventory before recovering the survey core.
starbridge.message.vault_reward: Survey core recovered. Each player may claim one from this vault.
starbridge.message.moon_status: Survey Moon: %s · custodian %s · survey core %s · oxygen %s s
starbridge.error.copied_identity: Copied core identity replaced; pair computers and authorize agents again.
starbridge.error.unowned_agent: An unowned core cannot grant agent access.
starbridge.error.gravity_range: Gravity compensation must be between 0 and 30.
starbridge.error.not_on_ship: This core is not part of an assembled ship.
starbridge.error.ship_changed: The ship changed during launch; launch cancelled.
starbridge.error.launch_timeout: Launch was not confirmed within 2 seconds; the ship stayed docked.
starbridge.error.docked: The ship is docked. Press L at the helm (or /starbridge launch) first.
starbridge.error.launch_pending: Launch in progress; wait a moment or cancel with X.
starbridge.error.assemble_first: Assemble a ship around this core first (use a hull marker).
starbridge.error.backend_incompatible: The installed Valkyrien Skies version is not compatible.
starbridge.error.no_energy: No energy. Right-click the core with fuel or a star fuel cell, or pipe in FE.
starbridge.error.launch_rejected: The physics engine did not accept the launch.
starbridge.error.launch_failed: Launch failed; the ship was returned to its dock.
starbridge.error.gravity_incompatible: Could not read this dimension's gravity.
starbridge.error.invalid_mass: The physics engine reported an invalid ship mass.
starbridge.error.thrust_limit: The required thrust exceeds the drive limit.
starbridge.error.insufficient_energy: Not enough energy; the drive disengaged.
starbridge.error.physics_stopped: Ship physics stopped responding; the drive disengaged to save energy.
starbridge.error.force_rejected: The physics engine rejected the drive force.
starbridge.error.out_of_limits: That destination is outside flight limits.
starbridge.error.launch_cancelled: Launch cancelled; the ship stays docked.
starbridge.error.other_core: Another core is already flying this ship.
starbridge.error.jump_no_route: No star route from this dimension.
starbridge.error.jump_no_destination: The destination world is not available on this server.
starbridge.error.jump_chart: Carry a star chart to plot a jump.
starbridge.error.jump_failed: The physics engine refused the jump; the ship did not move.
starbridge.error.computer_unpaired: This computer is not paired. The owner must run /starbridge computer pair <id>.
starbridge.error.agent_disabled: Agent access is disabled for this core.
starbridge.error.human_pilot: A player is at the helm; manual control has priority.
